content: Indi Bepaŋdut kwanai tiyam doktiŋa haniŋgigine tiŋa indiŋ haniyam. Bepaŋ’walaŋ siloŋ tobogoŋ tihamuŋit uyadi folooŋnit mokit mu tibaak.
Biyagoŋ kuyoŋ, Bepaŋdi indiŋ yoguk hatak. “Nu naine momooŋ gineŋ dutok nadisugut eŋ tubukedeba nai gineŋ hehitubu-lodagut.” Nadiiŋ be? Nai momooŋ agaŋ iŋakoŋ, eŋ tubukedeba nai maaŋgoŋ iŋakoŋ.
Aposel heki adi Bepaŋ’walaŋ kwanai hati tulune malabumuŋ fee mintayemguk
Indi yadi meeniŋdi kwanainikdok yohaŋinda tineeneŋ yoŋa nemek niŋ foloŋ talik yokamehep mu tiyemam.

Indi yadi Bepaŋ’walaŋ kwanai-me hatiyam wondiniŋ mebi miŋgoŋ indiŋ tiŋa tubumintayam. Folofigita gineŋ hatiŋale fiit baigoŋ hinek nadikulemayam. Mik-kwadi gineŋ hatiyam, nindihi nihikele tulune hatiyam, malabumuŋ gineŋ hatiyam,
kwanaimiŋ foloŋ hatiyam, yot fafaŋeniŋ gineŋ ikam, memik lekiŋgoŋhik gineŋ hatiyam, kwanaidok folofigita nadiyam, damo kaipmuŋ hatiyam, nanaŋe map hatiyam,
yomnit mokit hatiyam, nadidakalenit hatiyam, welekulemanit hatiyam, menot tiyemam, Uŋgoniŋ Munabulinit hatiyam. Welesiloŋ folooŋ hinek hatnimbune hatiyam,
mede folooŋ biyagoŋ hinek yoyam, Bepaŋ’walaŋ saŋiniŋ foloŋ hatiyam, Bepaŋ’walaŋ Mede Momooŋ diniŋ tebe bohom moŋgolaŋa kweletalak tagiŋa hatiyam,
yokadaka eŋ youtumba lekiŋgoŋhik gineŋ hatiyam, yalaŋ-me niniiŋ iŋgoŋ yomnit mokit hatiyam.
Indi’walaŋ mebinik kayoŋbop nolidi lohi tiiŋ, iŋgoŋ nolidi kedem nadinimiiŋ, agaŋ kumuŋdok tiyam iŋgoŋ fiit hatiyam, nindihi tubukadaka tigiŋ iŋgoŋ fiit mu liweyam.

Bulaniŋgoŋ tinimiiŋ iŋgoŋ fiit nadifo foloŋ hatiyam, hambeep iŋgoŋ meeniŋ fee siloŋ tiyemam, nemek lohilohi tiyam iŋgoŋ Bepaŋdi duhuduhu fee nimilak. Mulabumuŋ be kedem nadiyam iŋgoŋ indi fiit Bepaŋ’walaŋ kwanai fafaŋe tiŋa tiyam.
Pol adi meeniŋ Kolinhi weleŋdi kisaŋ yabukahileguk
O Kolinhi metam, biyagoŋ kuyoŋ, welenikdi hidi kisaŋ habukahileyam u manikdi miŋgilaŋgoŋ hanimbihikam.
Welenikdi habukahile-fafaŋe hinek tiyam, iŋgoŋ hidi inditok mu nadiiŋ.
Ale wapmihineye, nu behik nabugoŋ mede i hanimbit: Kibi hidibo nibukahile hinek tiyaneeŋ.
Kadakaniŋ eŋ kedem adi menot mu tiyamuk

Meeniŋ Kilisto mu nadisukilitimiiŋ adi titiŋ hogohi tubune hidi mu yehitubu-lodaaŋ tiyaneeŋ. Titiŋ didimeniŋ eŋ titiŋ hogoli adi deti menot tide welekubugoŋ tidemek? Be hauta eŋ mambip adi deti yofolok tidemek?
Be Kilisto eŋ Sadaŋ adi welekubugoŋ tuwot mu tidemek. Be me nadisukilitinit eŋ me nadisukilitinit mokit adi dediŋ tiŋa kiutemek.
Be Bepaŋ’walaŋ Siloŋyot eŋ bepaŋ yalayalaŋ adi dediŋ tiŋa kiutemek. Abe nadiiŋ, Bepaŋ Hatihati Molom adi’walaŋ Siloŋyot adi indi kuyoŋ. Ale Bepaŋ adi indiŋ hinek-ku yoguk oŋ.

content.text: “Nu lekiŋgoŋhik gineŋ ipilat tibaat. Unduŋ tiŋa Bepaŋhik hatibene adi metamneye hatineeŋ.”
“‘Ale hidi meeniŋ nadisukilitihinit mokit biyabuŋa tabayem taneeŋ.’ Wapumdi unduŋ yolak.”
“Tiŋa nemek kadakahi dadagiyehi yehiyehiye mu taneeŋ. Kaŋ nu habukahileeŋ hanagilaat.”
“‘Tiŋa nu Behik hatibene hidi wapmihineye hatineeŋ.’ Wapum, Saŋiniŋ Molom adi unduŋ yolak.”
